description: Delete a deployed agent. This cannot be undone: the agent disappears from every list at once, its data is removed later and there is no restore. The order is: cancel the plan with manage_agent_billing (no refund for the rest of the period), stop the agent with control_agent, then delete it. Without confirm: true the tool only checks what is still in the way and describes the deletion; repeat the call with confirm: true after the user agrees. On a team agent this needs a team admin or the person who deployed it.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents.

confirm.description: false only checks and describes the deletion. true deletes the agent. Set it only after the user agreed.

name: delete_agent
title: Delete a Wiro agent
